This week's roasts

Eighteen single-origin lots on the shelf this week, roasted in 12-kilo batches and shipped within 48 hours of the roast date. Every bag carries its roast day, lot number, and the curve we used.

Free shipping on orders over $40. Subscribers save 10% and pick their grind.
